textSegments: Complies with ATX12V V2.52 / Flex ATX V1.23
Compliant with UL/EN/IEC international safety standards
Quiet and long-lasting 40mm ball bearing fan
Black cables for the need of enthusiasts
Complete protections: UVP, OVP, SCP, OPP, OTP
Fully modular design with all black ribbon cables simplifies installation and allows you to use only the cables you need, for a neater and mechanical build.
FlexGuru series featured with high power density, 20% higher than any Flex PSU in same wattage and frame.
Standing out from FLEX-ATX PSU marketing, FSP pioneered the development of Beetle technology for FlexGuru series, strengthening the fixation adequacy by 25% to fit in most of the Flex-ATX chassis.
Unlike general FLEX PSUs, FlexGuru series with inner 40mm fan design block the noise and achieve maximum cooling at all times.
The efficiency of your power supply directly affects your system's performance. FlexGuru 250W offer the high conversion power to boost your system.

FSP Group features the latest in green power technology, and provide a full kinds of additional safety approvals to keep designs ahead of the changing regulations.  FSP has upgraded the majority of power supplies to the new IEC 62368 standard for your system.

OVP (Over Voltage Protection), UVP (Under Voltage Protection), OPP (Over Power Protection), SCP (Short Circuit Protection), and OTP (Over Temperature Protection), a full guardian circuit protections to keep your hardware safe.
Using Japanese electrolytic capacitors, FlexGuru series offers the stable output and long-term reliability you need.
